role: Abstract marker base for weather entities (its only vanilla subclass is EntityLightningBolt); it adds nothing but a constructor that calls super(World), and marks the entity as living in World.weatherEffects rather than the loaded entity list.
scope_reason: Interface, marker or abstract base; its behavior lives in the subclasses' ports (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md).

members.name: EntityWeatherEffect
members.note: A plain super(World) call with no added behavior. The native engine never models the class: the concrete subclass is folded straight into struct lightning_bolt (lightning.h's comment notes it belongs to World.weatherEffects, not loadedEntityList), and the generic Entity base init has no EntityWeatherEffect-specific symbol.

members.name: __OBFID
members.note: Compiler-injected obfuscation constant (groups the file's static constants).

missing: EntityWeatherEffect itself has no native counterpart: the port represents the concept only as the World.weatherEffects bolt list (struct lightning_bolt *bolts in csrc/engine/serverreplay.h), not as a shared weather-effect base.
notes: No behavior of its own to port, so not_ported is a formality: the subclass (EntityLightningBolt) is ported and test-proven in csrc/engine/lightning.c. The cited evidence exercises the concrete subclass, whose construction passes through this base constructor. No other vanilla subclass exists: grep over oracle/src found only EntityLightningBolt extending EntityWeatherEffect.
